prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-high-fashion editorial portrait of one original approved adult woman seated in an oversized textured faux-fur armchair against a dark studio background.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult woman with slicked-back hair, minimal makeup, sharp natural facial structure, calm intense gaze toward camera, and composed powerful body language. She wears a luxurious icy-blue faux-fur coat over tailored black trousers and black pointed heels, with legs crossed, one hand on the armrest and the other near her chin.
composition_elements: Centered seated three-quarter to full-body portrait in an oversized charcoal textured fur armchair.
Crossed-leg pose with clear coat texture, black tailoring, pointed heels, and relaxed arm placement.
Dark moody studio gradient with restrained negative space and no text.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft cinematic key light with controlled side fill and subtle rim light, emphasizing fur fibers, facial structure, and black fabric against deep shadows.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, realistic skin pores and fur fibers, subtle 35mm grain, restrained cool color grade, no text or watermark.
